title: A timely remembrance of the martyrs
english: Beloved, a timely occasion has arisen to bring remembrance of good martyrs. This remembrance imitates the celebration of the heavenly orders, for the intercession and salvation of our souls. So all of you who know God, stretch out your ears here today, so that you may be deemed worthy of the prize of the martyrs now being spoken of. For these are the ones we must praise and marvel at: they had not yet seen the incarnation of Christ, nor the death of the Immortal One, nor the resurrection from the dead, and yet even before the incarnation they were his martyrs and confessors.
